text:
Three main uses of the hand are gripping or grasping objects, touching to sense texture, temperature and pressure, and gesturing to communicate (pointing, signing, waving). "Five main uses" isn't a fixed standard list, so these are common categories rather than an official set. The team note's examples (gripping, percussive striking, sensory gathering) are consistent with this, though I'm only partly confident in any one classification.

CONFIDENCE: 68
